text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki and I are working toward the Arima Kinen, but we need breaks too. On one particular rest day…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer, let's celebrate early! It's close enough to the 25th, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Might I interest you in a production of Romeo and Juliet?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's how we end up going to watch a play together.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What a great rendition! Even though I knew how the play would end, I still cried.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Thou desperate pilot, now at once run on the dashing rocks thy seasick weary bark! Here’s to my love."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "O true apothecary, thy drugs are quick. Thus with a kiss I die."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now I remember how difficult those lines are! I wanted to get them just right, so I practiced a lot.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, right, you don't know. I played Romeo in my youth troupe.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I remember being really nervous because it was the first main role that I earned the chance to play.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I muttered lines under my breath all day long at home until my mom got angry at me!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. This sure brings me back. I never would have thought back then that I'd change my path to racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Listening to Fuji Kiseki tell me about her childhood, our trip back to campus seems to take no time at all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thanks for coming out with me today! Even though it's a bit early, I truly felt a festive cheer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, before I forget, I have a gift for you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Consider it a token of my gratitude. Thank you for everything you do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look at the neatly wrapped box. It looks like there might be a piece of jewelry inside.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The stone has a special meaning.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It means, "May our bond remain eternal." I imbued it with this wish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I open the box to find a necklace inside with a small diamond that sparkles like sunlight glinting off the ocean.
choice_data_list: Is it all right if I put it on now?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try to put it on, but the clasp is small and my fingers are clumsy. As I'm struggling…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Let me see it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She takes the necklace from me and has it clasped around my neck in no time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It looks great on you. I'm glad I chose a smaller stone.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I didn't want it to be too flashy, since I was hoping you'd wear it every day…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Don't take that too seriously! Anyway, good night!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This day with Fuji Kiseki becomes one of my warmest and loveliest memories.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It looks just as nice on you as I thought it would.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That means a lot to me. Also, um…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh! That vending machine sells really tasty hot cocoa. Do you want to try it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sorry. That was a bit random, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What I mean to say is… the day feels like it went by really fast.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I was hoping we could spend some more time together… if that's all right with you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Here you go. It's hot, so be careful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The cocoa Fuji Kiseki hands me is sweeter and more delicious than I expected it to be.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thanks for spending time with me despite how busy you are. I really appreciate it.
choice_data_list: I'm glad you invited me out.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You're too nice for your own good.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You know…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: When I was young, I couldn't understand the ending of Romeo and Juliet at all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I didn't get why the two of them pined so desperately for each other.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And I wondered what it would feel like to have someone so precious to me that I would rather die than be without them.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But now, I finally understand what it means to have a truly irreplaceable person in my life.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Could it be because I've grown older and wiser… or because I've met you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I wonder… Which do you think it is?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haha! I'm just messing with you. Did your heart skip a beat?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki looks at me with an impish expression filled with smiles and mischief.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oho? What's wrong? Your face is all red.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This day with Fuji Kiseki becomes one of my warmest and loveliest memories.
